title: A $p$-adic Riemann--Hilbert correspondence over Robba rings
summary: We construct overconvergent period sheaves $\mathcal{O}\widetilde{\mathbb{C}}^{I,\dagger}$ and $\mathcal{O}\mathbb{B}_{\mathrm{dR}}^{\dagger,+}$ on the $v$-site of a liftable semi-stable formal scheme $\mathfrak{X}_Z$. By establishing a decompletion theorem for small representations, we prove a $p$-adic Riemann-Hilbert correspondence relating small $\widetilde{\mathbb{C}}^I$-local systems (resp. $\mathbb{B}_{\mathrm{dR}}^+$-local systems) on the generic fiber $X_Z$ to small flat connections on the associated period ringed spaces.
